title: AE40007: Introduction To Helicopter Engineering
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Prerequisites: AE21002
3 - 0 - 0: 3 CreditsIntroduction, Differences
with fixed wing aircraft, Helicopter components and performance requirements,
Introduction to hovering theory, Hovering and vertical flight performance
analysis. Autorotation in vertical descent, physical concepts of blade motion
and rotor control aerodynamics of forward flight, forward flight performance,
tail rotor, Helicopter force, momentum and power equilibrium, Control of
helicopter, Introduction to helicopter vibration problems.
